assets.name: board-colour

Quiet subtle taupe-gray mineral mottling, fine varied pores and softened ancient-looking wear in the material itself, with no specific artifact copied. No perspective, rim, slab edge, bevel, vignette, gradient, directional light, cast shadows, highlights or depth lighting. Diffuse even neutral light throughout. No holes, bowls, pits arranged in a game grid, pieces, stone tokens, lines, coordinates, border, letters, decorations, cultural symbols, logos, text or objects. Actual board pits will be modeled separately, so this image must only contain subtle natural material grain, not a picture of a finished game board.
Output: one high-resolution opaque square PNG. Original generated surface art suitable as a continuous colour map over a real recessed 3D board. Keep it spacious and visually quiet at playing scale.
